brief:
The Guardian's documentary "NAZA" features testimony from 24 Israeli officials discussing surveillance and remote killing operations targeting Palestinian civilians, the outlet reported. The film is currently in cinemas worldwide and will become available for free streaming on the Guardian's website beginning in early December.

The documentary centers on accounts from Israeli personnel involved in these operations, providing direct witness testimony to the mechanisms and decision-making behind the targeting of Palestinian civilians in Gaza.
dek: Film features testimony from 24 Israeli officials involved in surveillance and remote killing of Palestinian civilians • NAZA is in cinemas worldwide and will screen for free on the Guardian’s website from early December.
title: Guardian releases documentary on Israeli surveillance and killings in Gaza
